description: Two independent two-input logic gates, one switching between OR and NOR, the other between OR and exclusive OR

params.text: Illuminated, its output carries the OR of that section's switched-on inputs; dark, it carries the NOR, resting at 5V and falling to 0V whenever a switched-on input goes high
Includes that input in its section's logic result while it is on, and leaves it out of the result while it is off
Illuminated, its output carries the OR of that section's switched-on inputs; dark, it carries the exclusive OR, which is high only when exactly one switched-on input is high

inputs.text: A gate or trigger into one section's logic, counted as high from 1V upwards

outputs.text: Carries 5V when the OR or NOR result of its section is high, and 0V when it is low
Carries 5V when the OR or exclusive-OR result of its section is high, and 0V when it is low
